acceptance.gate: Phase 4 gate G4 per master-plan v2.1 §9: f1 within 1% of 80.8 Hz (Coreform immersed 81.8); random RMS error <= 1.79% + 0.5%p; spectrum combination rules match hand calculation to 1e-10.

implementation_parity.note: On an identical modal basis Coreform-vs-Abaqus worst relative difference in the excited component must be <= 5e-6, and the immersed error additionally within 4x the body-fitted one. Whole-field measures are recorded for transparency but NOT gated.

boundary_conditions.clamp: root face at z = 0 fully clamped
boundary_conditions.excitation: primary base motion in global y (weak bending direction of the section)

geometry.note: Same beam as the static cantilever-beam-bending study; square section makes every bending mode a degenerate pair and puts a torsional mode inside the analysis band.

loads.random_response: flat base-acceleration spectral density across the band (vibration qualification shape)
loads.shock_spectrum: base-acceleration shock spectrum rising to a plateau then rolling off; tabulated at modal damping ratio (magnitudes m/s^2 vs Hz — full table only partially captured in crawl; record authoritative table as unknown, see note)
loads.shock_spectrum_table_note: Crawled text captured fragments (20 @10 Hz, 200 @100 Hz, 200 @600 Hz, 60 @2000 Hz, 5 @ ...) with ambiguous pairing; the authoritative Table 4 must be re-read from the source page before use.

materials.note_nu_zero: zero Poisson's ratio so the 3D solid reproduces the 1D beam-theory accepted frequencies

mesh_sweep.body_fitted: structured C3D8, 50.0e-3 m, solved end-to-end by Abaqus/Standard
mesh_sweep.immersed: Coreform IGA rectilinear grid, 25.0e-3 m; Coreform post-processes random/spectrum from the modal basis (Abaqus/Standard cannot post-process random/spectrum for user elements)

provenance.reference_doc_sections: §2 Geometry (Table 1), §3 Material (Table 2), §4 Excitation & analysis settings (Tables 3-5), §6 accepted Euler-Bernoulli frequency, §7 Results (Tables 6-8)

reference_values.participating_modes_note: Gate on participating modes only: the square section puts a torsional mode in-band that a linear immersed basis renders ~14% stiff (mode 5) but carries no participation in transverse base motion.
